# Language Zone

> Language Zone is a German language institute at Race Course, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. It teaches German from A1 to C2, with every level following its Goethe-Zertifikat exam, in online and offline batches. Language Zone is a Brillica Services company.

Key facts:

- Courses: German A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 and C2, each preparing for the matching Goethe-Zertifikat (A1: Start Deutsch 1 up to C2: Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom).
- Teaching: certified trainers, a communicative approach, and mock tests in the real Goethe exam format.
- Modes: offline classes at the Dehradun centre and online classes; morning, evening and personalised batches.
- Address: Near Dwarka Store, EC Road, Race Course, above Admire Honda, near Survey Chowk, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001, India.
- Phone: +91 88821 40688, +91 89795 44473. WhatsApp: +91 89795 44473. Email: info@brillicaservices.com.
- Fees, batch dates and course duration are shared on a level-check call; they are not published on the website.

## German courses

- [German course in Dehradun, A1 to C2](https://languagezone.in/german): overview and comparison of all six levels and their Goethe exams
- [German A1 course (Beginner)](https://languagezone.in/german/a1): Introduce yourself and handle everyday phrases. Exam: Goethe-Zertifikat A1: Start Deutsch 1.
- [German A2 course (Elementary)](https://languagezone.in/german/a2): Describe your routine, the past and simple plans. Exam: Goethe-Zertifikat A2.
- [German B1 course (Intermediate)](https://languagezone.in/german/b1): Give opinions, write emails, manage most situations. Exam: Goethe-Zertifikat B1.
- [German B2 course (Upper intermediate)](https://languagezone.in/german/b2): Join discussions and write formal, detailed texts. Exam: Goethe-Zertifikat B2.
- [German C1 course (Advanced)](https://languagezone.in/german/c1): Fluent, flexible German for study and career. Exam: Goethe-Zertifikat C1.
- [German C2 course (Proficient)](https://languagezone.in/german/c2): Nuance, precision and the highest Goethe certificate. Exam: Goethe-Zertifikat C2: Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom.

## Guides

- [German Classes in Dehradun: How to Choose the Right Course](https://languagezone.in/blogs/german-classes-in-dehradun-how-to-choose): What to look for in a German language course in Dehradun, from Goethe-Zertifikat preparation to batch timings and class size.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat Levels Explained: A1 to C2 for Learners in Dehradun](https://languagezone.in/blogs/goethe-zertifikat-levels-explained-a1-to-c2): A clear guide to the six Goethe-Zertifikat levels, what each exam tests and which one your goal needs.
- [How to Start Learning German from Zero in Dehradun: A 30-Day Plan](https://languagezone.in/blogs/learn-german-from-zero-dehradun-30-day-plan): A simple first-month plan for complete beginners, with daily habits that make German A1 easier.
- [Which German Level Do You Need to Study in Germany? A Guide for Dehradun Students](https://languagezone.in/blogs/german-level-to-study-in-germany-from-dehradun): What German universities usually ask for, and how students from Dehradun can plan their German levels around an intake.
- [Der, Die or Das? Three Habits That Make German Articles Stick](https://languagezone.in/blogs/der-die-das-german-articles-tips): Practical habits our trainers in Dehradun use to help learners remember the gender of German nouns.
